book.name: A̠luk
book.title: Ib̠eb̠i Asu̠gbagba Ma̠ Agu̠o̠ A̠luk Age̠ Bho̠

content: E! Wa̠ a̠lei abar A̠tiofilo̠s, a̠d̠izo a̠nwunom na̠ e̠ge̠ ma̠ i̠di̠ar ya̠ na̠ omuzoghod̠iom d̠a̠ esa̠d̠io d̠a̠ i̠yar,
ma̠ agu̠o̠ i̠pu̠r ronyob̠a̠ bho̠ i̠gba ma̠ ib̠eb̠i asu̠gbagba bho̠ inigha̠ i̠yar bho̠.
O̠ku̠a a̠d̠ighi be̠le̠ni̠, agu̠o̠ bho̠ ami̠ na̠ amar a̠bhin obhel a̠lelegi ma̠ eb̠la̠ i̠di̠ar ka̠ d̠a̠ o̠pu̠r ob̠eton bho̠, akpe̠ ami̠ ma̠ o̠ge̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n oselegi onigha̠ onyom,
ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ anwa ta̠ amar a̠loghom iya̠gia̠ga̠i bho̠, ma̠ d̠a̠ i̠di̠ar ya̠ na̠ o̠tu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ ma̠ anwa bho̠.
Ogua̠n I̠mara ta̠ Azo̠n Owurmamu̠m
D̠a̠ obhel ola̠ E̠ro̠d aro̠ ma̠ O̠li̠la ebhugh A̠zudia̠, okur ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ola̠ ubhelegi ma̠ Azakaraya d̠a̠ ebu rokur ta̠ Abi̠za aro̠. E̠li̠zabe̠t ani̠ d̠o̠yo̠ eka̠ ola̠ eghun ta̠ Ero̠n.
I̠wal awa irugh a̠ma̠rugh igielake̠ d̠a̠ a̠misigh ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠, sa̠ ikoko ma̠ eb̠la̠ roloko na̠ i̠to̠to̠gi̠ ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠; e̠kal ola̠ o̠li̠o̠m awa na̠ o̠ro̠ d̠o̠.
Ya̠a̠ awa o̠nyi̠ na̠ o̠ro̠ d̠o̠, ezin bho̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t aro̠ ma̠ e̠marani̠. Awa na̠ e̠mar eten ikei-a̠nwunom.
Igiel bho̠ a̠gir ate̠i̠ ebu rokur ta̠ Azakaraya ma̠ ogir ogir-okur ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠a̠ Otuta̠zib̠a̠ bho̠,
sa̠ awa irobh okob̠a̠ ibhin i̠so̠n Azakaraya ma̠ d̠a̠ ed̠ighiom i̠di̠ar rokur bho̠, ma̠ od̠igh d̠a̠ Otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ o̠su̠o̠m i̠tani̠ ed̠u-e̠nu̠nu̠.
Igiel bho̠ a̠lei o̠su̠o̠m i̠tani̠ ed̠u-e̠nu̠nu̠ bho̠, eb̠la̠ o̠lo̠gh a̠nwunom ya̠ i̠ro̠ d̠a̠ a̠kokod̠ia̠n bho̠, i̠ro̠ d̠a̠ etire na̠ esiseiny.
Sa̠ orileduom ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ a̠mutuma̠ i̠na d̠a̠ agba od̠iom enwen i̠ko̠l i̠tani̠ ed̠u-e̠nu̠nu̠ bho̠.
Igiel bho̠ Azakaraya abi̠gh orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠, sa̠ Azakaraya a̠kpa̠ra̠noma̠, sa̠ a̠rugugu isibh i̠na.

Ya̠a̠, orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠: “Azakaraya, ko oghil a̠rugugu; na̠ o̠mu̠gho̠n a̠siseiny d̠oyom. Ani̠ d̠oyom E̠li̠zabe̠t ta̠ amar olobhiri o̠nyi̠ a̠nigha̠ nya̠m, sa̠ anwa ta̠ a̠ghol i̠na ma̠ Azo̠n.
I̠na ta̠ a̠bhin a̠libhon ologi na̠ ibo a̠ruom anwa, sa̠ a̠d̠izo a̠nwunom ta̠ ebhon ologi d̠a̠ ebula̠ i̠mara d̠o̠yo̠.

I̠na ta̠ abu̠gh d̠a̠ a̠misigh ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠. I̠na ko o̠d̠a d̠o̠ na̠ o̠d̠a ma̠ a̠min ya̠ na̠ epuru ma̠ o̠ni̠, ya̠a̠ ta̠ obhin E̠mu̠gh E̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠ o̠lo̠gh d̠a̠ ozu d̠o̠yo̠, omuzoghod̠i d̠a̠ okurogh, kisa̠ ta̠ o̠mar i̠na.
I̠na ta̠ a̠d̠ighi ma̠ ola̠ a̠d̠izo a̠nwunom Izre̠l ta̠ etiba̠ra̠ eru d̠a̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠awa.

I̠na ta̠ a̠d̠ia̠ a̠ru na̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠, sa̠ ta̠ a̠bhin a̠d̠ien e̠mu̠gh na̠ a̠limon ya̠ I̠lai̠za a̠rughom bho̠, a̠tulugi ma̠ rologi ta̠ ronweni na̠ ro̠we̠de̠, na̠ anwi̠i̠ny d̠awa; sa̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ e̠b̠agh e̠mu̠ bho̠ ta̠ etiba̠ra̠ erugh a̠ghud̠um igielake̠, na̠ o̠tu̠ghu̠man a̠nwunom ya̠ ta̠ e̠ro̠ eb̠a̠ra̠ ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠.”
Sa̠ Azakaraya a̠pura̠n orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ ma̠a̠, “Ami̠ ta̠ a̠d̠ighi eka̠ a̠ma̠ra̠ ma̠ abar onon, i̠se̠n wa̠ ani̠ d̠ami̠ na̠ ami̠ na̠ o̠kpo̠ bho̠?”
Sa̠ orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ awo̠ran i̠na ma̠a̠, “Ami̠ A̠gebre̠l. Ami̠ na̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ a̠misigh ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠, sa̠ I̠na a̠ruom ami̠ ma̠ o̠gba ib̠eb̠i asu̠gbagba i̠nye̠n onigha̠ oyom.

Nagha, anwa ko orue mu a̠fugh abar tu̠tu̠n ta̠ ate̠i̠ a̠d̠a̠ma̠ wa̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n ta̠ emite bho̠; ezin bho̠, anwa na̠ oma̠ra̠ d̠o̠ ma̠ asu̠gbagba d̠ami̠ ya̠ ta̠ emite d̠a̠ obhel bho̠ na̠ o̠to̠ oguri bho̠.”
Igiel bho̠ a̠nwunom na̠ e̠ro̠ na̠ eb̠a̠ra̠ ma̠ Azakaraya bho̠, sa̠ a̠d̠igh awa ma̠ ilologia̠n o̠bi̠gh ma̠ i̠na na̠ aro̠ na̠ a̠bia̠ d̠a̠ Otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠.

Igiel bho̠ i̠na a̠mite a̠ru bho̠, i̠na na̠ orue d̠o̠ ma̠ ofugh abar, sa̠ awa iloghom ma̠a̠ i̠na na̠ abi̠gh aghi̠m d̠a̠ Otu ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠, ezin bho̠ i̠na aro̠ ma̠ i̠tu̠o̠gho̠m i̠tu̠o̠gho̠m ya̠ na̠ orue d̠o̠ ma̠ ofugh abar omutiom.
Obhel bho̠ i̠na na̠ a̠gir a̠muzoghod̠iom d̠a̠ ra̠d̠a̠ma̠ ya̠ u̠to̠ unigha̠ i̠na bho̠, sa̠ i̠na a̠ten a̠yel d̠a̠ otu d̠o̠yo̠.
Na̠ obia̠ d̠o̠, sa̠ ani̠ d̠o̠yo̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t a̠mumor, sa̠ a̠bhin ogho uwetire aro̠ ma̠ esi ola̠ o̠yo̠.
Sa̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t a̠fugh ma̠a̠, “I̠se̠n Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ na̠ a̠kpon ami̠ ma̠ igbirigbir asi̠ghe̠ ma̠ ari̠ghe̠l d̠ami̠ d̠a̠ esa̠d̠io a̠nwunom.”
Ogua̠n I̠mara ta̠ A̠zizo̠s
Igiel bho̠ eghun ta̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t a̠lei odin uwetire bho̠, sa̠ A̠zib̠a̠ a̠ruom orileduom d̠o̠yo̠ A̠gebre̠l, ma̠ o̠gi̠ d̠a̠ Anazare̠t e̠ma ola̠ od̠i d̠a̠ Agalili,
ka̠ o̠bi̠ghan e̠kar o̠nyani̠, ola̠ ubhelegi ma̠ A̠meri, ola̠ odi o̠nyi̠ eghun ta̠ A̠devidi, ola̠ ubhelegi ma̠ A̠zose̠fu̠, na̠ a̠sibh obhin ani̠.
Sa̠ orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ a̠mutuma̠ ma̠ A̠meri a̠fugh ma̠a̠, “Ami̠ a̠bheleguma̠ ma̠ anwa o, anwa wa̠ e̠no̠gho̠man na̠ e̠te̠i̠ bho̠! Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ od̠i na̠ anwa.”
Sa̠ ikpo a̠fugh d̠o̠yo̠ i̠lo̠gh e̠mi̠ i̠su̠su̠ghu̠d̠i̠ ma̠ A̠meri, sa̠ i̠na aru̠ru̠an a̠gboloma̠ ma̠ ezin ipelegima̠ bho̠.
Sa̠ orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ a̠fugh a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠, “A̠meri, ko oghil a̠rugugu, e̠ne̠ghe̠ ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ na̠ e̠te̠i̠ anwa.
Anwa ta̠ a̠mumor amar olobhiri o̠nyi̠, sa̠ anwa ta̠ a̠ghol a̠d̠ien d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ A̠zizo̠s.
I̠na ta̠ abu̠gh e̠mi̠ sa̠ ta̠ obhelegi i̠na ma̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ Wagi̠manyu̠ A̠pu bho̠. Wa̠nwuna̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ta̠ a̠nigha̠ i̠na ma̠ i̠kasi̠ o̠li̠le̠ma e̠ma o̠we̠de̠ d̠o̠yo̠ A̠devidi,
sa̠ i̠na ta̠ a̠rileghom otu ta̠ A̠zeko̠pu̠, ad̠u̠a ma̠ amu̠m a̠ten amu̠m; ekunuguma̠ ko o̠ro̠ d̠o̠ d̠a̠ irileghom d̠o̠yo̠.”
Sa̠ A̠meri a̠pura̠n orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ ma̠a̠, “Abar onon ta̠ a̠d̠ighi eka̠ a̠mite, ma̠ agu̠o̠ ami̠ ta̠ ologhom d̠o̠ ma̠ olobhiri-o̠ni̠ bho̠?”

Sa̠ orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ awo̠ran ma̠a̠, “E̠mu̠gh E̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠ ta̠ a̠sor a̠ru ra̠ a̠mutuma̠ nyam, sa̠ a̠limon ta̠ Wagi̠manyu̠ A̠pu bho̠ ta̠ a̠ghughuom anwa; ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ o̠nyi̠ e̠tu̠tu̠ wa̠ ta̠ o̠mar bho̠, ta̠ obhelegi ma̠a̠ O̠nyi̠ ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠.
Kpone, E̠li̠zabe̠t a̠ghisia̠n d̠oyom eka̠ na̠ a̠mumor olobhiri-o̠nyi̠ ma̠ i̠se̠n i̠na na̠ akpo̠ bho̠. Ughol gha̠n i̠na ma̠ a̠d̠ien ma̠ i̠na e̠marani̠, ya̠a̠ onon odin uwetire i̠na od̠i na̠ eghun.
Ezin bho̠, abar ola̠ akpar a̠pu ma̠ A̠zib̠a̠ ma̠ ogir bo̠.”
Sa̠ A̠meri awo̠ran ma̠a̠, “Ami̠ ob̠a̠ra̠motu ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠. Omuzughod̠iom onigha̠ ami̠ ma̠ agu̠o̠ anwa i̠gba bho̠.” Sa̠ orileduom ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ bho̠ awe̠le̠man i̠na a̠ten ad̠u̠a.
A̠meri agi̠ ka̠ a̠zua̠n E̠li̠zabe̠t
D̠a̠ obhel obha̠, sa̠ A̠meri a̠nugia̠n a̠kokod̠ia̠n agi̠ d̠a̠ e̠ma ola̠ od̠i d̠a̠ ebhugh a̠rugugum
d̠a̠ A̠zudia̠,
sa̠ a̠d̠igh d̠a̠ otu ta̠ Azakaraya sa̠ a̠bheleguma̠ ma̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t.

Igiel bho̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t amu̠gho̠n ibheleguma̠ ta̠ A̠meri bho̠, sa̠ o̠nyi̠ wa̠ ta̠ o̠mar d̠o̠ bho̠, wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ otu-imara d̠o̠yo̠ bho̠ a̠nyegia̠n, sa̠ E̠mu̠gh E̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠ a̠d̠igh d̠a̠ ozu ta̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t a̠muzo.
Sa̠ a̠bhin okoroko ola̠ agi̠ ma̠ anyu̠ a̠fugh ma̠a̠: “A̠zib̠a̠ na̠ a̠tutumeni ma̠ anwa a̠pu d̠a̠ e̠ma ra̠ anwani̠, na̠ a̠tutumeni ma̠ o̠nyi̠ wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ otu-imara d̠oyom bho̠!
Ezin ka̠ ere ka̠ e̠no̠gho̠man iya̠ o̠ko̠no̠n na̠ eru ra̠ e̠te̠i̠ ami̠, ma̠ ola̠ onweni ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ d̠ami̠ ta̠ a̠ru ra̠ a̠zua̠n ami̠?
Agu̠o̠ okoroko ibheleguma̠ d̠oyom a̠d̠igh d̠a̠ a̠to d̠ami̠ bho̠, sa̠ o̠nyi̠ wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ okurogh d̠ami̠ bho̠ a̠bhin a̠libhon ologi a̠nyegia̠n.
Itutumeni e̠ro̠ enigha̠ i̠na wa̠ a̠ma̠ra̠ ma̠a̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ ta̠ a̠muzoghod̠iom i̠di̠ar ya̠ i̠na a̠gua̠n a̠nigha̠ i̠na bho̠.”
Aso̠r itutumeni ta̠ A̠meri
Sa̠ A̠meri a̠fugh ma̠a̠,

content.text: “Eloghoma̠n ozu d̠ami̠ na̠ a̠tutumeni ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠.
E̠mu̠gh d̠ami̠ na̠ a̠bhon ologi na̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ A̠zib̠a̠ Witenemeni d̠ami̠,
ezin bho̠ i̠na a̠loghom ado̠l o̠ki̠ri̠me̠ni̠ ozu ob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠.
A̠b̠eton i̠se̠n agi̠ d̠a̠ ed̠ia̠,
ad̠u̠a ma̠ amu̠m a̠ten amu̠m ta̠ obhelegi ami̠ ma̠a̠,
wa̠ na̠ otutumeni bho̠,
ezin bho̠, i̠na Wa̠ A̠limon i̠bu̠gh ipu bho̠ na̠ a̠gir ibom i̠di̠ar a̠nigha̠ ami̠.
E̠tu̠tu̠ bha̠ a̠d̠ien d̠o̠yo̠.
Igbirigbir d̠o̠yo̠ na̠ e̠te̠i̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ eghila̠n i̠na bho̠,
ad̠u̠a ma̠ amu̠m a̠ten amu̠m.
I̠na na̠ a̠bhin aru̠gu̠o̠ d̠o̠yo̠ a̠gir ibom i̠di̠ar;
i̠na na̠ asasaragi̠ ma̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ e̠bu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ ma̠ a̠ruzu d̠a̠ i̠ru̠ru̠an d̠awa.
I̠na na̠ a̠sorogi ma̠ ogbo i̠rileghom bho̠ d̠a̠ ra̠dila̠de d̠awa,
ya̠a̠ i̠na na̠ a̠b̠egion ogbo ya̠ olei d̠o̠ ma̠ abar bho̠.
I̠na na̠ a̠nigha̠ ma̠ ib̠eb̠i i̠di̠ar ogbo ya̠ od̠i ma̠ o̠ko̠i̠ bho̠ ma̠ od̠e olegha̠n,
sa̠ a̠ze ma̠ aru̠li̠la bho̠ ma̠ oyel obhobho i̠kpo̠.
I̠na aru̠ru̠an okpon igbirigbir d̠o̠yo̠ abhe̠l ob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠ Izre̠l,
na̠ Ebraham na̠ anwi̠i̠ny igha̠la̠ d̠o̠yo̠ kid̠ud̠ul,
ma̠ agu̠o̠ i̠na a̠gua̠n a̠nigha̠ ma̠ ro̠we̠de̠ d̠i̠yar bho̠.”

content: A̠meri a̠bhin agu̠o̠ i̠sar uwetire aro̠ na̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t ka̠ a̠mula̠ a̠yel d̠a̠ otu d̠o̠yo̠.
I̠mara ta̠ Azo̠n Owurmamu̠m
Obhel bho̠ eghun ta̠ E̠li̠zabe̠t a̠legha̠n bho̠, sa̠ amar olobhiri o̠nyi̠.
Sa̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ erugh na̠ etua̠n i̠na bho̠, na̠ ogbo a̠ghisia̠n d̠o̠yo̠ id̠igh na̠ i̠na ibhon ologi ma̠ d̠a̠ obhel wa̠ awa i̠mu̠gho̠n ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ na̠ a̠kpon i̠na ma̠ ibom igbirigbir bho̠.
Oghol a̠d̠ien ta̠ Azo̠n Owurmamu̠m bho̠
D̠a̠ obhel wa̠ o̠nyi̠ bho̠ na̠ a̠lei o̠bhabhanya a̠d̠a̠ma̠ bho̠, sa̠ awa iru ra̠ oti ipo d̠o̠yo̠. Sa̠ awa iru ra̠ ogholom o̠yo̠ ma̠ a̠d̠ien o̠we̠de̠ d̠o̠yo̠ Azakaraya,
ya̠a̠ onweni d̠o̠yo̠ a̠fugh ma̠a̠, “E̠nyi̠! Ta̠ oghol i̠na ma̠ Azo̠n.”
Sa̠ awa i̠gba inigha̠ i̠na ma̠a̠, “Eb̠la̠ a̠ghisia̠n d̠inyin, o̠ni̠ ola̠ na̠ a̠d̠e ma̠ a̠d̠ien obha̠ bo̠.”
Sa̠ awa ibhin i̠tu̠o̠gho̠m ipura̠n o̠we̠de̠ d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ a̠d̠ien wa̠ i̠na ta̠ a̠ghol o̠nyi̠ bho̠.
Sa̠ i̠na a̠bhin i̠tu̠o̠gho̠m a̠puru ma̠ ad̠u̠b̠o̠ ola̠ obhin o̠ge̠ abar, sa̠ age̠ ma̠a̠, “A̠d̠ien d̠o̠yo̠ Azo̠n.” Sa̠ eb̠la̠ awa ib̠a̠gha̠gha̠.
D̠a̠ onin obhel bho̠ sa̠ o̠nu̠ d̠o̠yo̠ akpati̠na, sa̠ a̠nem d̠o̠yo̠ ako̠gi̠na, sa̠ i̠na ake̠ ma̠ ofugh abar, sa̠ a̠tutumeni ma̠ A̠zib̠a̠.
Sa̠ a̠rugugu isibh ogbo ya̠ na̠ erugh d̠a̠ eghighira̠ d̠awa bho̠. Sa̠ asu̠gbagba bho̠ i̠te̠i̠ eb̠la̠ ebhugh a̠rugugum A̠zudia̠, sa̠ a̠nwunom na̠ e̠b̠e̠re̠gi̠an na̠ egboloma̠ ma̠ i̠di̠ar i̠nye̠n.
Sa̠ eb̠la̠ ogbo ya̠ i̠mu̠gho̠n asu̠gbagba bho̠ ibhin i̠lo̠gh d̠a̠ rologi d̠awa, sa̠ odi na̠ a̠pura̠n odi ma̠a̠, “O̠gbara-o̠nyi̠ onon ta̠ a̠mite aro̠ eka̠?” Agu̠o̠ ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ od̠i na̠ i̠na.
Iwowa̠ ta̠ Azakaraya
Sa̠ E̠mu̠gh E̠tu̠tu̠ bho̠ a̠d̠igh d̠a̠ ozu o̠we̠de̠ d̠o̠yo̠ Azakaraya a̠muzo,

content.text: sa̠ i̠na a̠wa̠ ma̠ iwowa̠ ma̠a̠,
“Itutumeni e̠ro̠ enigha̠ ma̠ Wa̠nwuna̠, A̠zib̠a̠ Izre̠l,
ezin bho̠, I̠na na̠ a̠zua̠n a̠nwunom d̠o̠yo̠, ata awa a̠bhin.
I̠na na̠ a̠b̠eton o̠bhal itenemeni a̠nigha̠ i̠yar
d̠a̠ eghun otu ta̠ A̠devidi ob̠a̠ra̠motu d̠o̠yo̠,
agu̠o̠ i̠na a̠rughom a̠riwil e̠tu̠tu̠ d̠o̠yo̠ a̠gua̠n d̠a̠ obhel ola̠ na̠ a̠bia̠ bho̠,
ma̠ omiza̠n d̠a̠ agu̠o̠ ogbo o̠lo̠gi̠an a̠d̠ien d̠i̠yar,
na̠ d̠a̠ a̠limon ogbo ya̠ na̠ e̠su̠a i̠yar bho̠.
I̠na aru̠ru̠an i̠zo̠ e̠tu̠tu̠ d̠o̠yo̠,
sa̠ i̠na a̠nwuna̠ ma̠ okpon igbirigbir a̠nigha̠ ma̠ ibom ro̠we̠de̠ id̠ud̠ul d̠i̠yar,
i̠zo̠ ya̠ i̠na a̠d̠ed̠ia̠n na̠ o̠we̠de̠ d̠i̠yar Ebraham bho̠:
ma̠ otenemeni i̠yar d̠a̠ aru̠gu̠o̠ ogbo o̠lo̠gi̠an a̠d̠ien d̠i̠yar, b̠o̠ka̠ i̠yar ubhin a̠rugugu o̠ko̠l i̠na,
ya̠a̠ obhin d̠a̠ e̠b̠ab̠ala na̠ ado̠l igielake̠ o̠ro̠ d̠a̠ a̠misigh d̠o̠yo̠,
ma̠ eb̠la̠ ra̠d̠a̠ma̠ a̠ghud̠um d̠i̠yar.
Sa̠ anwa, o̠nyi̠ d̠ami̠,
ta̠ obhelegi nyam ma̠ owil ta̠ Wagi̠manyu̠ A̠pu bho̠;
ezin bho̠ anwa ta̠ aro̠ d̠a̠ ed̠ia̠ ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠, ma̠ o̠tu̠ghu̠man eten bho̠ onigha̠ o̠yo̠,
na̠ o̠tu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ a̠nwunom d̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ eloghom abar oten,
wa̠ awo̠l d̠a̠ okpon i̠karabh o̠si̠ghe̠ a̠d̠ien a̠ru bho̠,
d̠a̠ ebula̠ okpon igbirigbir ta̠ A̠zib̠a̠ d̠i̠yar,
ogogo wa̠ na̠ a̠b̠etina̠ ma̠ ad̠i̠ro̠ bho̠ ta̠ ad̠u̠a d̠a̠ ote̠nai̠ny amu̠o̠m i̠yar
ma̠ onigha̠ e̠b̠alab̠al ogbo ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ azi̠m,
na̠ ogbo ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ i̠ku̠nu̠ omugh bho̠,
na̠ orileghom re̠b̠ab̠a a̠sike d̠i̠yar ka̠ od̠ighom d̠a̠ eten ekima̠.”

content: Sa̠ o̠nyi̠ bho̠ a̠bhobh sa̠ aghu̠a d̠a̠ e̠mu̠gh. A̠rugh d̠a̠ e̠ghana tu̠tu̠n ate̠i̠ obhel wa̠ i̠na ake̠ ma̠ ogir d̠o̠yo̠ d̠a̠ Izre̠l bho̠.

footnotes.text: I̠tani̠: I̠tani̠ ed̠u e̠nu̠nu̠. I̠d̠i̠ar ya̠ na̠ ebhur ed̠u e̠nu̠nu̠, ya̠ na̠ o̠bhu̠gi̠ na̠ onigha̠ ma̠ aru̠mu̠gh; na̠ obhin na̠ o̠ko̠l i̠ko̠l.
A̠rugugum: A̠d̠ien a̠rugugum i̠nye̠n bo̠ d̠a̠ A̠b̠ureni; i̠nye̠n od̠i ka̠ i̠gbara rigu.
